blocks.text: Programming mein variable computer ki memory mein ek dabba (storage container) hai jis mein data rakha jata hai, aur baad mein code mein usay nikala aur badla ja sakta hai. Neeche ki misaal mein variable age mein number rakha gaya hai. Program chalte chalte variable ki value badal sakti hai, isi liye isay "variable" (badalne wala) kehte hain:

print("As - Salaam-Alaikum , dear students ! ")
age = 71
print( "Quaid-i-Azam lived for", age, "years")
age =60
print ( "Allama Iqbal lived for", age, "years")

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab pehli line print ( age ="As - Salaam-Alaikum , dear students ! ") chhapti hai. Yeh chalti nahi: print() ko age naam ka argument nahi diya ja sakta, is liye TypeError aata hai. Sahi line: print("As-Salaam-Alaikum, dear students!") (oopar wale code mein yahi line, kitab ke spaces ke saath, di gayi hai).

Is misaal mein variable age ko pehle 71 aur phir 60 diya gaya, ta ke Quaid-i-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah aur Allama Iqbal ki umrein dikhayi ja sakein. Output yeh hai: "Quaid-i-Azam lived for 71 years" aur "Allama Iqbal lived for 60 years" (salaam wali line ke baad).

blocks.prompt: Python mein variables ka concept (khayal) samjhaiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Variable aisa naam hai jo memory mein rakhi value ki taraf ishara karta hai; yeh assignment se banta hai (age = 17), is ki value baad mein parhi aur badli ja sakti hai (age = 18), aur value ki type (int, float, str, bool) rakhi gayi value se tay hoti hai. Naam naming rules ke mutabiq aur meaningful (jin se matlab samajh aaye) hone chahiyein.

items: Variable: memory mein naam wala dabba; value badal sakti hai (age = 71, phir age = 60).
